content.text:
Fixed. Your example now returns `'line1\nline2\nline3\r'`, and the 303 existing tests pass. I didn't add a regression test, and I didn't re-run your fuzz.

**Cause:** `isWin` treated the final `+line3\r` as a Windows-style line, so `applyPatch` converted the patch with `winToUnix` and stripped the `\r`. But a line followed by `\ No newline at end of file` has no line ending, so a `\r` there is part of the content.

**Fix:** in `src/patch/line-endings.ts`, `winToUnix`, `isWin` and `isUnix` now ignore a trailing `\r` when the next hunk line is a `\` marker. I changed `isUnix` too so it agrees with the other two. `unixToWin` already skipped those lines.
